text: APPROVE. The extracted `IsFirstPartySource` keeps the same extension, generated/declaration and skip-dir checks, and `&& --count == 0` still only decrements for first-party files, so behaviour is unchanged. Pulling three `if`/`continue` blocks out of the nested loop should bring `AtLeast` under 15, and the helper is small, with one `if` and a few boolean operators. Nothing in the diff should break the build, since the `IsSkipped(file, root)` overload and `SourceExtensions` already exist.
